name: Wooblay Supervision
description: Enterprise agent supervision — blocks tool calls pending approval, generates signed receipts, builds audit trails. All tool execution is routed through Wooblay Gate for policy evaluation.

gateUrl.description: URL of the Wooblay Gate server

toolFilter.description: Which tools to gate: all, only risky, or a custom list

customToolList.description: Tool names to gate (only when toolFilter is 'custom')

approvalTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for approval decisions (default: 5 minutes)

approvalPollIntervalMs.description: Poll interval in ms when checking approval status
